title: user.registered payload
description: Payload of the user.registered event (auth-service, docs/architecture.md §3.1). OQ-13: auth-service renders the full verification link, so the raw one-time token MUST NOT travel in the event.

user_id.description: Identifier of the newly registered user (string-encoded).

verification_url.description: Ready-to-send email verification link; contains the opaque one-time token. Replaces the raw verification_token (OQ-13).
